name: PatchNet
aliases: Patch-Based Generalizable Deep Implicit 3D Shape Representations
definition: A mid-level surface representation where an object is represented as a combination of surface patches, each representing the surface within a specified radius from its center, allowing for generalization across object categories and controllable deformation via explicit patch extrinsics.
summary: PatchNet represents 3D objects as learnable surface patches optimized directly during training, enabling controllable deformation and generalization across categories.
